The '''space-time continuum''', also known as the '''space-time fabric''', or simply '''space-time'''<ref name="CV">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref> was a way to transfer between dimensions, provided the continuum was "ripped" which created a hole between each place. [[Waru]] was transported to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Realspace/Legends|universe]] through such a rip in the fabric of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-[[Time/Legends|time]], and back to [[Waru's universe|his own]] again in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].
